plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.À l'ajout d'une commande, ses changement: When a command is added, its state changes are imported from the Jeedom history over this number of days (if the command is historized). Default 90.
plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.Les changements d'état plus anciens sont: Older state changes are deleted every night: habits follow the season. Default 90, minimum 7.
plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.Un allumage plus long est pris pour une: A longer switch-on is taken as a missed switch-off (box stopped, bridge offline): it is discarded, and the days it touches are not counted for its group. Default 18.
plugins/presencehabituelle/plugin_info/c.Habitudes et règles « en semaine » / « l: Habits and rules "on weekdays" / "at the weekend": by default from Friday 16:00 to Monday 04:00 (Friday to Sunday evenings, Saturday and Sunday mornings). Adapt it to your rhythm (work on Saturday, back on Sunday noon…), then Recompute the trends.

plugins/presencehabituelle/core/class/pr.La commande d'absence doit être binaire: The absence command must be binary or numeric (true during the absence): a text mode will not do, use a binary virtual

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Exceptions : jours loin de la moitié cen: Exceptions: days far from the middle half, by more than 30 min and by more than 1.5 times its spread (whichever is larger).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Ouverture du matin : seulement si le vol: Morning opening: only if the shutter was closed at 04:00. A partial closing (against the sun) does not count.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Journée de 04 h à 04 h. Week-end : matin: Day from 04:00 to 04:00. Weekend: Saturday and Sunday mornings (04:00-16:00), Friday and Saturday evenings (16:00-04:00).

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.d’après leur nom : montrées dans la list: from their name: shown in the list as lights, unticked
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.même lampe vue par deux commandes (ou de: same lamp seen by two commands (or two lamps always switched together): ticked = unticked in the list
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Observation des commandes sans historiqu: Watching the commands without history until

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.rien à comparer : le plugin peut relever: nothing to compare: the plugin can record their changes for a few days, then run the discovery again
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Rien n’est enregistré tant que vous ne c: Nothing is saved until you click Save.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.s’allume à heure fixe ?: switches on at a fixed time?
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.signalées seulement : à décocher vous-mê: flagged only: untick them yourself if a program switches them on
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Leurs relevés seront effacés : si vous l: Their records will be deleted: if you tick them again, only the Jeedom history is imported (90 days, a few hours for a smoothed history). Continue?
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.absences possibles (ou journées sans lum: possible absences (or days without light, in summer): tick if you were away; ticked = added to the periods not to analyse
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.relancez la découverte ensuite (relevés: run the discovery again afterwards (records kept 7 days after).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Rien n’est enregistré tant que vous ne c: Nothing is saved until you click Save. The records of commands removed in the meantime do not come back: only the Jeedom history is imported.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Jeedom n’en garde qu’une moyenne horaire: Jeedom only keeps an hourly average: nothing to compare. Set their smoothing to "None" (command configuration, History tab), or watch them
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Ajoutez d’abord un étage dans l’onglet P: Add a floor first in the Plan tab.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Aucune lampe ni aucun volet suivi : répo: No lamp or shutter followed: answer "Yes" to question 1.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Cliquez pour la placer sur le plan (pièc: Click to place it on the plan (rooms and passages are drawn in the Plan tab).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Doublon : la même lampe vue par une autr: Duplicate: the same lamp seen by another command (keep the other one). Group: a command that switches several lamps already listed. No: a fridge plug, a status LED…
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Est-ce une lampe ou un volet de la maiso: Is it a lamp or a shutter of the house?
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Ne jamais la simuler (ni pendant l’absen: Never simulate it (not even while away)
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Simulation proposable : chaque lampe et: Simulation can be proposed: each followed lamp and shutter has habits, ranges or is set aside. Nothing is started for now.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Une fois enregistrées, leurs changements: Once saved, their changes are recorded every day. Meanwhile, a "may switch on" range (question 3) is enough for the simulation.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.attendez, ou donnez une plage « peut s’a: wait, or give a "may switch on" range
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.commande(s) sans réponse à la question 1: command(s) without an answer to question 1 (not followed).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.commandes ont changé ensemble : une seul: commands changed together: a single lamp? Keep the one that stands for it, the others become its duplicates.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.non historisée : les relevés commencent: not historized: records start when saved
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.à compléter avant de proposer une simula: to complete before a simulation can be proposed.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.historique lissé : seules les dernières: smoothed history: only the last hours are taken back when saving
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.historisée : son historique est repris à: historised: its history is taken back when saving
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.« Peut s’allumer » : seulement dans ces: "May switch on": only within these ranges; "never on": never within these. From 23:00 to 07:00 crosses midnight; from 00:00 to 00:00 = the whole day. Weekdays and weekend: as in the plugin configuration (by default the weekend runs from Friday 16:00 to Monday 04:00).
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.est déjà un doublon : choisissez la comm: is already a duplicate: choose the kept command.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.à revoir : la commande gardée n’est plus: to review: the kept command is no longer followed
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Plage sans heure de début ou de fin (que: Range without a start or end time (question 3)
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Identifier en allumant ou en ouvrant: Identify by switching on or opening
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.Ouvrez le volet en identifiant : la vale: Open the shutter while identifying: the value shown is the open one
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.allumez ou éteignez une lampe, ouvrez ou: switch a lamp on or off, open or close a shutter: what changes shows up here, with its value
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.aucun changement relevé : volet sans ret: no change recorded: shutter without state feedback (Somfy RTS…)? Its habits cannot be drawn: give it a "may open" range (question 3)
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/js/pr.d’après leur nom : montrés dans la liste: from their name: shown in the list as shutters, unticked

plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Tout est calculé sur cette box : le plug: Everything is computed on this box: the plugin sends nothing to anyone, and only administrators can see the trends (they are part of the Jeedom backups, like the rest of the database). For now the plugin draws from your history the trends, the exceptions and what never happens: it does not switch on or close anything yet.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Cochez les lumières et les volets à anal: Tick the lights and shutters to analyse. Plugs and media are offered unticked: a plug may power a fridge or a router, that is not presence. Sensors are not used: they say nothing about what you do.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Groupe : les lampes d'un même groupe son: Group: lamps of the same group are analysed together (a room). Empty = the lamp alone.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Vos absences (et toute période où une si: Your absences (and any period when a simulation was running) distort the trends: those days are not counted.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Commande info binaire ou numérique, vrai: Binary or numeric info command that is true during an absence (e.g. a binary virtual “Away” or “Holiday”; a text mode will not do): its active periods are excluded. Optional.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Une par ligne : AAAA-MM-JJ HH:MM → AAAA-: One per line: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM → YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (time is optional). Any day touched is excluded entirely.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Facultatif. Un plan par étage : déposez-: Optional. One plan per floor: upload its image, place the followed lights and shutters, draw the rooms (they group the lamps inside them, unless a group is typed), the passages between rooms (doors, corridors, staircases, including from one floor to another) and the zones to exclude (neither analysed nor simulated). The image stays on the box, visible to administrators only.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Cherche dans l'historique les doublons,: Looks in the history for duplicates, groups, lights without a generic type, days with nobody home and automatic lights: proposals, to be confirmed
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Recharge dans la liste le choix d'avant: Reloads into the list the choice from before the last save: nothing is saved until you click Save
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Le plugin ne sait rien de votre maison :: The plugin knows nothing about your house: it reads your devices and their history, then asks you four questions. Your answers are for the future simulation; for now, nothing is switched on or closed.
plugins/presencehabituelle/desktop/php/p.Les réponses, les règles, le choix des c: The answers, the rules, the choice of commands (next tab) and the plan are saved together.
